payload.rebuttal: fixed: The witness test_every_turn_carries_the_drivers_wall_clock_not_the_librarys built its CellSpec through the test's own _spec() factory, whose max_turns default of 60 is a separate literal on session.CellSpec, not the one on intake.Spec at saffron/intake.py:167. In production a spec with no max_turns: line gets its default from intake.Spec via task.spec_ceilings, so the test's own literal never exercised that path and could not detect a change to it. I changed tests/test_session.py to parse a bare spec with parse_spec, the same function real specs go through, and pass its max_turns into the CellSpec the test drives. I confirmed the fix by reproducing the exact mutant (intake.py's default changed from 60 to 61): the old test stayed green under it, and the new test fails with 915.0 != 900.0, then reverted the mutant and confirmed the real code still passes.
